title: Console Commands (Papyrus)
content:
The following Console Commands have effects on or are related to the Papyrus script system.
- AttachPapyrusScript
- CallFunction
- CallQuestFunction
- CallGlobalFunction
- DumpPapyrusDistanceEvents
- DumpPapyrusEventRegistrations
- DumpPapyrusPersistenceInfo
- DumpPapyrusStacks
- DumpPapyrusTimers
- DumpPapyrusLOSEvents
- ReloadScript
- SetPapyrusQuestVariable
- SetPapyrusVariable
- ShowQuestVars
- ShowInventoryVars
- ShowVars
- StartPapyrusScriptProfile
- StopPapyrusScriptProfile
- StartPapyrusStackRootProfile
- StopPapyrusStackRootProfile
- StartPapyrusFormProfile
- StopPapyrusFormProfile
- TogglePapyrusGlobalProfiler
- TogglePapyrusLog

Example:
And for an informational overlay of the Papyrus system's activity, you can enter:
 mgo add PapyrusStats

See Also:
- Papyrus
- Console Command
